# Home Visiting Applied Research Collaborative (HARC)

> > HARC is a HRSA-funded practice-based research network advancing precision home visiting through innovative research methods, intervention science, and workforce development for early childhood family services.

The Home Visiting Applied Research Collaborative (HARC), founded by Anne Duggan at Johns Hopkins, serves as a national hub for home visiting research methodology, behavioral intervention techniques, and service coordination frameworks. HARC develops the Precision Paradigm approach to tailor evidence-based home visiting interventions for maternal-child health and early childhood outcomes.

## Key Topics

- Precision Paradigm
- Home Visiting Research Methods
- Intervention Techniques Taxonomy
- Family Engagement
- Service Coordination
- Behavioral Pathways
- HRSA and ACF Programs
- Workforce Development
- Maternal-Child Health
- Child Maltreatment Prevention
- Research Design and Evaluation
- Self-Efficacy Theory
- MIECHV Program
- Practice-Based Research Network

## About HARC

- [Mission and History](https://hvresearch.org/mission-and-history): HARC mission as HRSA-funded practice-based research network for home visiting
- [Anne Duggan, ScD](https://hvresearch.org/people/anne-duggan-scd): Director Emerita at Johns Hopkins, HARC founder and home visiting leader
- [Jill Filene, MPH](https://hvresearch.org/people/jill-filene-mph): HARC leadership team member from James Bell Associates, evaluation expert
- [Nichole Sturmfels, MPH](https://hvresearch.org/people/nichole-sturmfels-mph): HARC Data Manager specializing in tribal home visiting evaluation

## Precision Paradigm and Innovation

- [Changing the Home Visiting Research Paradigm: Model's Perspectives on Behavioral Pathways and Intervention Techniques to Promote Good Birth Outcomes](https://hvresearch.org/resources/changing-the-home-visiting-research-paradigm-models-perspectives-on-behavioral-pathways-and-intervention-techniques-to-promote-good-birth-outcomes): Precision paradigm perspectives on behavioral pathways for birth outcomes
- [Innovation Toward Precision Home Visiting](https://hvresearch.org/resources/innovation-toward-precision-home-visiting): Plenary presentation on precision home visiting innovation by Anne Duggan
- [Home Visiting Research Network: Home Visiting Research Agenda](https://hvresearch.org/resources/home-visiting-research-network-home-visiting-research-agenda-october-29-2013): 2013 research agenda defining home visiting research priorities by Duggan

## Research Methods and Training

- [Home Visitor Research Training](https://hvresearch.org/resources/innovative-research-methods-toolkit): PCORI-supported video training modules for home visitor research methods
- [Theories of Behavior Change and Behavior Researcher Surveys: Methods](https://hvresearch.org/resources/theories-of-behavior-change-and-behavior-researcher-surveys-methods): Methods for behavior change theory and researcher surveys in home visiting
- [Balancing Rigor with Complexity in Understanding the Impacts of Child Maltreatment Prevention Programs](https://hvresearch.org/resources/balancing-rigor-with-complexity-in-understanding-the-impacts-of-child-maltreatment-prevention-programs): Korfmacher on research design for child maltreatment prevention programs

## Intervention Techniques and Theory

- [Intervention Technique Taxonomy: Behavior-Focused Techniques](https://hvresearch.org/resources/intervention-technique-taxonomybehavior-focused-techniques): Taxonomy of behavior-focused intervention techniques for home visiting
- [Self-Efficacy Theory](https://hvresearch.org/resources/self-efficacy-theory): Self-Efficacy Theory resource for Precision Paradigm intervention research
- [Directory of Self-Report Measures of Internal Engagement](https://hvresearch.org/resources/directory-of-self-report-measures-of-internal-engagement): Directory of family engagement self-report measures for home visiting

## Service Coordination and Healthcare Integration

- [Service Coordination in Home Visiting](https://hvresearch.org/resources/service-coordination-in-home-visiting): Toolkit with framework and self-assessment for service coordination
- [Coordination Between Home Visiting Programs and Medical Homes](https://hvresearch.org/resources/coordination-between-home-visiting-programs-and-medical-homes): Research brief on healthcare coordination barriers and facilitators
